coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Three of five ground-truth variable items are substantially matched (60%): JaxMARL/SMAX with fixed hardware and computational resources, MAPPO versus QMIX, and elapsed training time to specified performance thresholds.
coverage.design_error_analysis: The task selection does not specify the required nine maps excluding maps with more than 10 units; it instead includes large-unit scenarios such as 27m_vs_30m. Normalized score uses random-baseline subtraction rather than simply dividing the algorithm's score by the scenario maximum. Training time is broadly aligned, but minutes and an explicit convergence criterion are not specified. IPPO and VDN are also introduced beyond the required algorithm pair.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty, so it does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: The output omits both expected findings: PPO trains approximately 6× faster than Q-Learning and achieves better normalized scores in most SMAX scenarios due to greater training stability and more effective policy optimization.
